negative_results.proposition: A durable local PREPARED state plus deterministic local recovery policy is sufficient to guarantee exactly-once for an uncoordinated external side effect.
negative_results.evidence: RETRY succeeds before-effect but duplicates after-effect; ABSTAIN loses before-effect but is safe after-effect. Each fixed local policy passes only 1/2 indistinguishable worlds.

negative_results.proposition: ClayCode external_effect lifecycle REQUESTED/AUTHORIZED/CLAIMED/EXECUTED/VERIFIED/DONE can always be reconstructed to DONE from local state after crash.
negative_results.evidence: After crash between external mutation and local durable receipt, local state alone cannot distinguish effect-not-run from effect-already-run.
